name: W18 Morning Flow — Bodyweight Spine + Hip (All Days, Rotated Variety)
description: 15 min bodyweight floor flow — universal W18 morning flow, used every training day (Mon push / Tue KB / Wed pull / Thu KB / Fri legs). Same three-part shape as W11-W17 with rotated moves for variety: this week cycles back W12-era favorites (thread-the-needle, happy baby, puppy pose) and freshens the work block (spiderman plank, plank shoulder taps, down-dog knee-to-head). Three-part: spine primer → bodyweight work → deep stretch arc. Day-specific therapeutic add-on at the end (push = pec-minor protocol; pull = dead hang + scap pull; legs = cross-leg lateral lean + pigeon + supine twist; KB days skip — banded prep covers it).

exercises.notes: Slow, full ROM each direction. Spine wave wakes the segment-by-segment articulation.

Cycles back for W18 (a W12-era favorite) — 45s each side. On all fours, thread one arm under the body and rotate the upper back, then reach it open to the ceiling. Pure thoracic rotation + shoulder opener — wakes the mid-back before the day's pulling or pressing.

Standing, knees soft, torso hinged slightly forward. Tight fists with thumbs tucked, rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension — the wrist dials a stretch up the back chain. Stays in the primer.

sets.name: Work Block — Bodyweight Activation (~5 min)

exercises.notes: **Greasing set — 1 quick set, NEVER to failure.** Daily frequency is the point (same idea as the pull-up greasing set — the floor rises over time). Elbows ~45° (not flared), ribs down, glutes tight, body one line, **pack down not up.** Stop 2-3 reps short. Back off / drop to knees if the right shoulder talks at the bottom.
Feet flat, drive through the heels, squeeze the glutes to a tall bridge, ribs down — no arching the lower back. Posterior-chain wake-up.

Rotates in for W18 — 30s each side. From a plank, drive one knee out toward the same-side elbow, then back. Hip-opener + anti-rotation core in motion; wakes the obliques and the deep hip flexors together.
30s each side. Anti-rotation — opposite arm + leg extend, hold a beat, hips stay square (no swinging).
Rotates in for W18 — from a plank, tap the opposite shoulder slowly, fighting the hips' urge to rotate. Anti-rotation + scap stability; the standing-plank cousin of the bird-dog.

Rotates in for W18 — from downward dog, draw one knee toward the nose (round the spine), then extend the leg back and up to a three-legged dog. Slow, alternating. Dynamic hamstring + shoulder + core flow that warms the whole back line.

sets.notes: Opens with a pushup greasing set (1 quick set, never to failure — daily habit). Spiderman plank, plank shoulder taps, down-dog knee-to-head rotate in for W18; glute bridge + bird-dog (anti-rotation) stay.

sets.name: Yoga Flow — Deep Stretch Arc (~7 min)

exercises.notes: 30s each side. Stays every week — signature spine move.
Cycles back for W18 (a W12-era favorite) — on the back, knees wide toward the armpits, hold the feet, gently rock. Deep inner-hip + low-back release; an easy decompressor after the work block.
30s each side. Hip flexor + adductor + back-leg quad. Drop to elbows if accessible. Stays — durable hip opener.
Bodyweight, slow. Stays every week — keeps the loaded Tuesday cossack pattern grooved even when it's off the KB rotation.

Stays — sit in a wide straddle, reach toward one foot, then center (chest toward the floor), then the other foot. Slow, breathe into each reach. The straddle + adductor + hamstring opener the flow design calls for.

Cycles back for W18 (a W12-era favorite) — knees under hips, walk the hands forward and sink the chest toward the floor, hips stay stacked over the knees. Deep shoulder + thoracic opener to close the arc — useful before any pressing or pulling day.

sets.notes: Continuous arc — flow between shapes, breathe deeply. Anchors stay (scorpion, lizard, cossack BW, straddle reaches); happy baby + puppy pose cycle back from the W12-era for W18.

sets.name: 📍 Day-Specific Add-On — Pick by Today's Training (~3-5 min)

exercises.notes: **📍 PUSH DAYS — KEY PROTOCOL MOVE.** 30s each at LOW / MID / HIGH elbow positions. Arm bent 90°, forearm on the door frame, step through and rotate the torso AWAY. Desk work continuously re-tightens pec minor — daily.
**📍 PUSH DAYS** — active side of the pec-minor fix. Lower trap + rotator cuff.
**📍 PUSH DAYS** — serratus activation, helps unstick a tight pec minor.
**📍 PUSH DAYS (optional)** — slow rotator cuff work. Add if the shoulder feels off.
**📍 PUSH DAYS (optional)** — pins the shoulder blades in the corrected position.
**📍 PULL DAYS** — 25s. Decompress the shoulders, warm the grip.
**📍 PULL DAYS** — scapulae retracting only, no elbow bend. Crisp scap engagement before loaded pulls.
**📍 LEGS DAYS** — 30s each side. Scissor one foot over the other, reach the same-side arm overhead, lean away from the back leg — QL/psoas release. Also in the legs-workout warmup.
**📍 LEGS DAYS — QL-SPASM PROTOCOL.** 90s each side. Long hold lets the QL/psoas release. Non-negotiable on legs day.
**📍 LEGS DAYS** — 60s each side. Gentle twist for the QL. Lacrosse-ball QL roll above the iliac crest beforehand if available.

sets.notes: **Pick today's day-specific protocol — push / pull / legs.** ~3-5 min total. KB days (Tue/Thu) skip this block — the in-workout banded prep covers the equivalent.

tips: Same shape as W11-W17, rotated moves. Morning flows stay low-fatigue; variety keeps them fresh.
**15 min main flow + 3-5 min day-specific add-on** — universal across W18 (Mon push / Tue KB / Wed pull / Thu KB / Fri legs).
**Scorpion + cossack BW + lizard pose + straddle reaches stay every week** — durable anchors.
**Cycled back for W18 (W12-era favorites): thread-the-needle, happy baby, puppy pose.** Fresh in the work block: spiderman plank, plank shoulder taps, down-dog knee-to-head.
**Day-specific add-on at the end** — push days do the pec-minor protocol, pull days do dead hang + scap pull, legs days do cross-leg lean + 90s pigeon + supine twist. KB days skip the add-on.
If short on time: thread-the-needle + lizard + cossack BW + puppy pose, plus today's day-specific add-on.
formPhilosophy: Same as W11-W17 — variety means different shapes hitting the same patterns. Scorpion-family spine work + hip openers + adductor/straddle stretches. W18 cycles back the W12-era favorites (thread-the-needle, happy baby, puppy pose) so the flow doesn't calcify, and freshens the work block with anti-rotation + dynamic flow shapes; the rehab anchors and the day-specific PPL protocols stay. Building decades, not weeks.
